description: (0.5.0) Receipt-key status (RFC-ACDP-0010 §8 step 1, §9) and its use by RFC-ACDP-0014 §7 step 1. A verifier reports the receipt key as current (in assertionMethod) or historical (verificationMethod only). Under the strict profile, a pre-T placement of a context signed by a revoked key requires a current receipt key.

input.receipt: The rcpt-001 golden receipt and body; the registry DID document's key placement varies per scenario.

scenarios.name: A — receipt key in verificationMethod and assertionMethod
B — receipt key in verificationMethod only

expected.behavior: Reported as historical; MUST NOT be presented as a currently authorized registry attestation.

scenarios.name: C — receipt key absent from verificationMethod
D — revoked producer key, pre-T receipt under a historical receipt key

expected.behavior: The context is signed by revoked K1 and its receipt created_at is before T, but the receipt key is historical: under the strict profile it cannot place the context, which fails closed (RFC-ACDP-0014 §7 step 4). With a current receipt key the same context is historically authorized (pre-compromise). With no revocation of K1 at all, scenario B's historical receipt still supports the RFC-ACDP-0010 §10 historical-key rule.

notes: Behavioral; not executed by scripts/conformance-runner.py (no registry_test_keypair).
